messages:
Maria (docs): ok folks — big refactor incoming: moving /api/* -> /runtime/* across the site. I split the work into two PRs: #4782 (move pages + examples) and #4783 (redirects + canonical tags). Need sequencing advice and reviewers.

Kevin (eng): thanks. we should merge redirects first so links don't 404 while examples change. but redirects depend on exact new anchors — any anchor renames?

Samir (content): yes a few anchors changed in sdk-snippets.md (param names); I left a TODO in #4782. We can add alias anchors in the moved files to avoid breaking internal cross-links.

Alex (platform): docs-ci-bot is green on both PRs but preview ordering matters. If redirects PR merges after the move, Netlify preview will 404 during deploy. Our safe flow: 1) merge #4783 (redirects + aliases) -> 2) wait for prod docs build -> 3) merge #4782 (move). That keeps live links stable.

Lina (QA): +1. Also please add a preview checklist in the PR for smoke tests: check broken links, anchor jumps, sdk snippet execution (curl/ts examples). I can run a quick link-checker script.

Maria (docs): good — I'll update PR descriptions. Quick redirect snippet I plan to add (in _redirects.yml):

```
# redirects
- from: "/api/sdk-snippets#create-client"
  to: "/runtime/sdk-snippets#create-client"
  status: 301
```

Does that look OK? we need to ensure internal relative links in pages use canonical URLs once moved.

Kevin (eng): maybe use 302 for initial rollout then 301 after 2 weeks, so old cached links still resolvable during the canary period. Also set "preserve_query: true" for analytics.

Alex (platform): docs-ci-bot: deploy preview URLs:
- #4783 -> https://deploy-preview-4783--docs.redwood-inference.com
- #4782 -> https://deploy-preview-4782--docs.redwood-inference.com

docs-ci-bot: note: Netlify previews are isolated. Production redirect rules are applied only after merge to main and the site build.

Samir (content): small snag: reference in /guides/migrations.md points to old anchor /api/auth#token-flow which will be renamed. I propose we add a short migration note in migrations.md referencing both anchors for 30 days. PR #4784 created for that tiny change.

Maria (docs): ok add #4784 to the sequence. Updated plan:
1) merge #4783 (redirect rules + alias anchors)
2) merge #4784 (migration notes) -> optional before step 3 if you want the note live sooner
3) merge #4782 (file moves + snippet updates)

Lina (QA): who'll run the full link-check after each merge? I can run the automated link-checker and then a quick manual anchor test. Please ping me when each PR is merged.

Kevin (eng): reviewers: assign Alex + me for redirects, Samir + Maria for content changes, and Lina for final QA. Also flag "do not squash" on #4782 because we want history for moved files.

Maria (docs): noted re: do-not-squash. I'll add reviewers and the checklist to each PR. One more: CI flake we saw earlier — deploy preview sometimes times out for large images. Keep an eye on page assets; avoid embedding base64 screenshots in the PRs.

Alex (platform): to reduce preview time, we can temporarily enable incremental build for these PRs. I'll flip the flag for #4782 and #4783. Should speed Netlify builds.

docs-ci-bot: build status #4783 preview: SUCCESS  (link-check: passed)

Maria (docs): perfect. I'm going to merge #4783 after Alex confirms incremental builds are enabled and Lina signs off on link-check. Target window: tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT to avoid release deployments. Anyone object?

Kevin (eng): fine by me. I'll avoid scheduling infra changes in that window.

Samir (content): no objections. I'll re-run internal cross-link grep once redirects are live.

Lina (QA): I'll be on standby. After #4783 merges I'll run: `npm run linkcheck && ./scripts/anchor-smoke.sh` and paste results.

Maria (docs): thanks all. final note: after merges, let's monitor Sentry for any 404 spikes on /api paths and have a quick rollback plan (revert PR or change redirect status). I'll add a short monitoring playbook in the PR description. :+1:
